SDE1.scope: Only the frozen native queue's completed validation/reference chain is bound; no new native scientific replay or task-quality certificate.

audit_path_portability: Hash-bound assembly sources preserve original absolute provenance paths. The published reference index marks whether each path is bundled, already public, or local-only. These operational audit paths are not prerequisites for the portable public reproduction entrypoints.
credential_scan: No private-key/AWS/GitHub/HuggingFace literal candidates; bounded patterns only, no general security certification.
excluded: Wheels, native binaries, checkpoints, optimizer weights, generated compiler caches, tar archives and pyc files.
RoboLab rendered observation pixels and scene assets.
Credentials/private keys, retired RFC documents, and unnamed operational evidence.

Three broad dreamzero_memory_preparation_v1/*.file_inventory.json reclaim inventories: completion/precheck retain their hashes; scratch inode listings are local operational provenance, not README performance evidence.
SDE1 preparation tokenizer/vocabulary/model-card/media payloads: only65 exact named receipt/config candidates are eligible. No whole preparation or compiler-cache walk.
Generated README candidate Markdown remains local; its JSON binding is selected. Root-owned final README is separate.

report_renderers.scope: Generated candidates and final reader-entry hashes are bound separately. Root may edit final prose; this does not claim the final README equals its candidate.
